name: Leonux App Store
description: The live Leonux store repository — apps (single-file and multi-file zip packages), themes, widgets and sound packs, served straight from GitHub. Publish this folder anywhere static and paste the repo link into Leonux OS → App Store → Sources.

apps.name: Neon Snake
apps.desc: A glowing, multi-file take on the classic snake
apps.long: Neon Snake is the classic arcade snake rebuilt as a real multi-file app: a separate game engine, input controller, renderer and stylesheet, all shipped inside one .zip package. Glide around the grid eating energy orbs, grow longer, and speed up with every bite — how long can you get before you bite yourself?
apps.changelog: First multi-file release — index.html + css + js in one package

apps.name: Star Painter
apps.desc: Paint with glowing, rainbow and star-scatter brushes
apps.long: A pocket atelier with three hand-tuned brush engines: neon glow that leaves light trails, a rainbow brush that cycles the spectrum as you draw, and a star scatter that throws twinkling particles across the canvas. Pick colours, resize the brush, clear or export your art as PNG — all in a multi-file .zip package.
apps.changelog: First multi-file release — index.html + css + js in one package

apps.name: Synthwave Sequencer
apps.desc: A 16-step grid sequencer with synthesized drums and bass
apps.long: Build beats in seconds: four fully synthesized tracks — kick, snare, hats and a sliding acid bass — arranged on a 16-step grid. Dial the tempo, pick a preset, hit play and watch the playhead sweep. All audio is generated live with Web Audio, and the app ships as a multi-file .zip with separate audio engine, sequencer UI and stylesheet.
apps.changelog: First multi-file release — index.html + css + js in one package

apps.name: Zenboard
apps.desc: A calm three-lane kanban board for your day
apps.long: Zenboard keeps your day calm and organised: three lanes — To do, Doing and Done — with quick-add tasks, one-tap moves, priorities and a focus counter that celebrates every finished item. Built as a true multi-file app with separate data store, UI layer and two stylesheets, packaged in a single .zip.
apps.changelog: First multi-file release — index.html + css + js in one package

apps.name: Tic-Tac-Toe XL
apps.desc: Classic ✕◯ with an unbeatable minimax AI
apps.long: Tic-Tac-Toe XL brings the timeless duel to Leonux: play against a perfect minimax AI that never makes a mistake, or pass the keyboard for two-player matches. Score tracking, win highlighting and instant rematches included.
apps.changelog: Smarter AI, win-line highlighting and session scores

apps.name: Whack-a-Mole
apps.desc: 30 seconds of pure mole-smashing arcade
apps.long: Moles pop from nine burrows and you have 30 seconds to smash as many as possible. Build combos, watch for bonus rabbits worth 5 points, and chase your session best as the pace ramps up.

apps.name: Reaction Timer
apps.desc: Measure your reflexes in milliseconds
apps.long: The classic reaction test: wait for green, tap as fast as you can. Tracks your last, best and rolling 5-run average, and ranks you from Zen master to Cheetah tier. Watch out for the too-early trap!

apps.name: Dice & Coin
apps.desc: d4–d20 dice roller with coin flips
apps.long: A tabletop companion: roll any die from d4 to d20 (pips for the classics), flip a coin, or roll two and three dice at once with sums. Every result lands in the history strip so your table can audit your luck.

apps.name: Password Forge
apps.desc: Cryptographically strong password generator
apps.long: Forge passwords with the Web Crypto API: pick your length and character sets, watch live entropy bits and a strength meter, then copy with one tap. Nothing is stored or transmitted — generated locally, gone when you close the window.

apps.name: Age Calculator
apps.desc: Your life, in delightfully nerdy numbers
apps.long: Enter your birthday and get your age in days, weeks, heartbeats, breaths and trips around the sun — plus a countdown to your next birthday. A fun little statistics toy for your Leonux desktop.
apps.changelog: Full moons, Earth-laps and sleep estimates

apps.name: Piano Keys
apps.desc: A playable synthesizer keyboard
apps.long: A real Web Audio synthesizer: one or two octaves of ivory with proper black-key geometry, three voices (piano, electric, music box), adjustable sustain, and full keyboard mapping — the on-key letters show you where to press.

apps.name: Drum Pads
apps.desc: 12 synthesized drum pads with keyboard mapping
apps.long: A 12-pad drum machine synthesized entirely with Web Audio — kicks, snares, hats, toms, crash, cowbell and even a laser. Tap the pads or use the on-pad keyboard keys and start making beats in seconds.
apps.changelog: New laser pad and velocity tuning

apps.name: Typing Sprint
apps.desc: A 30-word race for your WPM
apps.long: Sprint through 30 random words while live WPM, accuracy and the clock tick beside you. Mistake tracking, session bests and a satisfying rank at the finish line. Great for warming up your fingers before real work.
apps.changelog: Live stats panel and rank titles

apps.name: Pixel Art Studio
apps.desc: Draw 16×16 pixel art and export PNG
apps.long: A pocket pixel editor: 12-colour palette, pen, flood-fill bucket and eraser on a 16×16 canvas, with a live miniature preview and one-tap PNG export at 16× zoom. Ships with a starter heart so you can start remixing immediately.
apps.changelog: Flood-fill bucket tool and in-app export

apps.name: Word Scramble
apps.desc: Unscramble tech words against the clock
apps.long: A word puzzle with a Leonux flavour: every round scrambles a tech word (with a topical hint), gives you 30 seconds, and rewards streaks with compounding points. Buy a letter hint for 3 points if you get stuck.

apps.name: Metronome
apps.desc: Precision metronome with tap tempo
apps.long: A musician's metronome built on Web Audio scheduling: 30–240 BPM with a big tap-tempo dial, 2/4 to 6/8 time signatures with accented downbeats, and visual beat dots. Space bar starts and stops.

apps.name: Simon Memory
apps.desc: The classic four-tone memory game
apps.long: Watch the pattern grow, then repeat it back. Each round adds a tone — how deep can your memory go? Synthesized tones, glowing pads and a round tracker keep your brain honest.
apps.changelog: Round progress dots and best-round tracking

apps.name: ASCII Art
apps.desc: Turn images and text into ASCII art
apps.long: Drop in a picture to convert it into characters, or render big block text. Adjust width, invert shades and copy the result.

apps.name: Barcode Maker
apps.desc: Create Code 39 barcodes and export as SVG
apps.long: Type text and get a scannable Code 39 barcode instantly. Adjust the height, download a crisp vector SVG or copy its markup.

apps.name: BMI Calculator
apps.desc: Body-mass index with metric and imperial units
apps.long: Enter height and weight in metric or imperial units and see your BMI, category, a colour scale and the healthy weight range.

apps.name: Shadow Lab
apps.desc: Design box-shadows and copy the CSS
apps.long: Sliders for offset, blur, spread, opacity and radius, inset toggle and custom colours — with ready-to-paste CSS output.

apps.name: Connect Four
apps.desc: Drop discs, line up four — vs a minimax CPU
apps.long: The classic vertical strategy game with a depth-limited minimax opponent. Choose Easy, Medium or Hard, track wins and draws, and hover a column to preview your drop.

apps.name: Loan EMI Calculator
apps.desc: Monthly instalments, interest and totals at a glance
apps.long: Slide amount, rate and tenure to see your EMI, total interest and total payment, with a principal-vs-interest chart.

apps.name: Fractal Tree
apps.desc: A wind-swept recursive tree through the seasons
apps.long: Tweak depth, branch angle and shrink factor, add wind and flip through the seasons. Every seed grows a different tree.

apps.name: Game of Life
apps.desc: Conway's cellular automaton, draw and evolve
apps.long: Paint cells, choose a preset pattern such as a glider or pulsar, and watch generations unfold at an adjustable speed on a wrap-around grid.

apps.name: Gradient Studio
apps.desc: Build CSS gradients visually and copy the code
apps.long: Linear, radial and conic gradients with up to eight colour stops, a live preview, randomise button and one-click CSS copy.

apps.name: Hangman
apps.desc: Guess the word before the gallows is complete
apps.long: Four word categories, on-screen and physical keyboard input, streak tracking and a hand-drawn gallows.

apps.name: Lorem Forge
apps.desc: Placeholder text in four flavours
apps.long: Generate paragraphs, sentences or words in classic Latin, hipster, corporate-tech or space-opera vocabularies — then copy.

apps.name: Mandelbrot Explorer
apps.desc: Zoom endlessly into the Mandelbrot set
apps.long: Click to zoom, right-click to zoom out, change the iteration depth and colour palette. Rendering is progressive so the UI stays responsive.

apps.name: Matrix Rain
apps.desc: Cascading code rain with adjustable style
apps.long: Falling glyphs in katakana, binary, hex or symbols, with speed, size and colour controls including a rainbow mode. Great as a screensaver window.

apps.name: Maze Runner
apps.desc: Procedural mazes — race through at growing sizes
apps.long: Every maze is freshly generated with a recursive backtracker. Steer with arrows or WASD and beat the clock as mazes grow larger each level.

apps.name: Morse Translator
apps.desc: Text to Morse and back, with audio playback
apps.long: Translate both ways as you type, hear the code via Web Audio at your chosen words-per-minute, and keep a reference chart at hand.

apps.name: Base Converter
apps.desc: Decimal, binary, octal, hex and any base to 36
apps.long: Edit any field and the others follow. Includes a 32-bit toggle grid, an ASCII preview and a custom base up to 36.

apps.name: Particle Toy
apps.desc: Thousands of particles that follow your pointer
apps.long: Attract, repel, swirl or burst up to 1,500 colourful particles with the mouse or touch. Toggle motion trails and watch the patterns.

apps.name: Reversi
apps.desc: Flip the board in this 8x8 strategy classic
apps.long: Outflank your opponent to flip their discs. Legal moves are highlighted, the CPU plays corner-aware, and scores update live.

apps.name: Solar System
apps.desc: Animated orrery of the eight planets
apps.long: Watch the planets orbit at relative speeds, click any world for facts, pause the clock, hide orbit lines and scrub the simulation speed.

apps.name: Sort Visualizer
apps.desc: Watch six sorting algorithms race
apps.long: Bubble, insertion, selection, quick, merge and heap sort animated on up to 150 bars with adjustable speed and a comparison counter.

apps.name: Tip & Split
apps.desc: Tip and bill splitter for dinner with friends
apps.long: Choose a tip percentage, set the number of diners and optionally round up each share. Clear totals, nothing more.

apps.name: Word Counter
apps.desc: Words, characters, reading time and top keywords
apps.long: Live counts for words, characters, sentences and paragraphs, estimated read time, keyword frequency and quick case tools.

apps.name: Bookmarks
apps.desc: Tagged, searchable link collection that remembers offline
apps.long: A tag-filterable bookmark manager with seeded favourites, visit counts, sorting, JSON import/export and persistent storage.

apps.name: Daily Journal
apps.desc: Private journal with moods, search and Markdown export
apps.long: A private daily journal: dated entries, mood picker, search, word count, autosave to on-device storage and Markdown export. Split into store.js and app.js modules.

apps.name: Color Palettes
apps.desc: Generate harmonious palettes, lock favourites, copy CSS
apps.long: Generate analogous, complementary, triadic, split or random palettes from a base colour, lock swatches, save favourites and copy CSS variables. Ships its own SVG logo asset.

apps.name: Periodic Table
apps.desc: All 118 elements, searchable and colour-coded
apps.long: All 118 elements in a colour-coded table with search, category filters, electron configurations and a detail panel. Data lives in its own js file — a multi-file package.

apps.name: Spirograph
apps.desc: Draw mesmerising hypotrochoid curves and save them as PNG
apps.long: Hypotrochoid curve designer with a maths module, progressive rendering, random presets and PNG export.
